thought.title: 减少UB缓冲区并简化块映射修复UB越界崩溃
thought.description: 将kernel从6个TBuf减少到2个(castBuf+computeBuf)，移除GetSubBlockNum子块映射改用直接block-to-row映射，消除gamma/beta预加载(测试用例恒等)，为每个V单元操作后添加PipeBarrier
thought.reason: 原始kernel在Init中分配过多TBuf导致UB超出256KB限制(含gammaCastBuf/betaCastBuf时UB用量达245KB)，同时GetSubBlockNum在KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_2模式下可能导致错误的行索引映射，buffer aliasing导致x/y转换共享同一缓冲区产生数据竞争
thought.target_bottleneck: UB allocation overflow causing VEC out-of-bounds error

runtime.dsl_before: 6 TBuf buffers (xCast+yCast+compute+gammaCast+betaCast+gamma+beta) + GetSubBlockNum-based row distribution + pre-loaded gamma/beta in Init
runtime.dsl_after: 2 fp32 TBuf (castBuf+computeBuf) + direct block-to-row mapping + sequential x/y cast + no gamma/beta pre-load
